package: LGA-8 2.5 x 2.5 x 0.93 mm, metal lid with vent hole

2.name: CSB
2.hint: I²C: connect CSB directly to VDDIO (required); a low level on CSB switches to SPI and disables I²C until the next power-on reset; internal pull-up 70–190 kΩ to VDDIO

3.name: SDI
3.hint: I²C SDA, open drain to GND but not pure open-drain: ESD diodes to VDDIO and GND – pull it up to VDDIO only

4.name: SCK
4.hint: I²C SCL, high-Z input with ESD diodes to VDDIO and GND (no clock stretching)

5.name: SDO
5.hint: I²C: address LSB – GND 0x76, VDDIO 0x77; must not be left floating (address undefined)
